Hi Team,

IPs Warmup Extension automates your entire IP warmup workflow directly from Firefox. No more manually clicking PAUSE, DELETE, RESET, SCHEDULE, and RESUME for every drop.

How it works: Open your deploy panel, click the extension icon after you Install it, paste your IPs with their targets, set your timing, and hit Start. The extension handles everything from there — sending emails, reading queues, scaling targets automatically, saving results to Google Sheets, and sending a Telegram report after every drop.

Just configure three things before you start:

  . Your IPs and send targets (1.2.3.4:5000)
  . Your timing (wait before resume, schedule loop duration, gap between drops)
  . Your Telegram Chat ID to receive reports
  . Your Google Sheets Link in Config.js

That's it. The process runs fully unattended until all drops are complete.

This is just the beginning — updates, new features, and improvements are coming

The next update is already in progress. Watch this space.

Hi Team,

A new update of the IPs Warmup Extension is now available, bringing several useful improvements.

What’s New

• The extension now verifies that servers are properly paused before starting the warmup process
• Improved overall behavior and stability when interacting with web pages
• New Data Lists mode is now available alongside the existing Lists Passive mode

Data Lists Mode – What’s New?

• Remembers where the previous warmup stopped and continues from that point
• Automatically loops back to the beginning once the end of the list is reached
• Ensures each drop uses a fresh set of seeds instead of repeating the same ones
• Automatically switches to Lists Passive mode once the Data warmup is completed

When and how should you use it?

• Use it when launching your process with Data Warmup
• Make sure to select Data Lists mode before starting
• Helps prevent overusing the same contacts and improves overall efficiency

Feel free to reach out if you need any assistance 🚀

Hey Team!

A slick new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is live. We’ve been busy under the hood — check out what’s new. 👇

🃏 ISP Shuffle Mode
We’re adding some randomness to your day. ISP profiles now shuffle once per session, so every run feels like a fresh spin of the wheel. The logic and quotas stay the same — just the order gets a little fun.

💬 Latest Messages – Now a Floating Buddy
A little panel now lives on the deploy page, checking in with TSSW Manager for new messages. Think of it as your helpful sidekick — the TSSW Team can reach you anytime without interrupting your flow.

✏️ Add / Update IPs on the Fly
A brand new textarea panel lets you toss in new IPs or tweak existing ones — while a session is still running. Changes are picked up before the next drop. Add new ones, update old ones, no drama.

🔁 IP Groups (Rotates Every Drop)
Want to mix things up even more? Now you can create multiple IP groups that rotate per drop. Cycle through them, then loop back. Each drop gets a fresh crew of IPs, and they’re cleaned up nicely after.

📊 Quota Tracking That’s Got Your Back
We’re keeping an eye on your remaining quota, sent emails, and warmup limits — Auto-refreshing via Our Main API. Delivery counts are reported after each drop. And if the API takes a nap? No worries — auto recovery kicks in.

Got ideas, questions, or you got problems? Don’t be shy — reach out anytime. 🙂

Cheers,
TSSW Team

Hi Team,

A new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is ready. This release brings smarter IP exclusion handling and an improved user experience.

Here’s what changed:

• Pause / Resume from MultiMonitors – A new option that lets you control pause/resume commands directly from the PMTA page. This bypasses previous portal-related issues and applies commands server-wide.

• IP check percentage control – Instead of randomly validating a single IP per command, you can now choose the percentage of IPs to verify. A new input field at the top of the extension form gives you full control.

⚠️ Important: The "Pause/Resume from MultiMonitors" feature is designed to run commands on the entire server at once.

Hi Team,

A new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is ready. This release includes a bug fix to improve the accuracy of the spam monitoring feature.

Here's what changed:

• Spam Rate Threshold Fix – The "Stop by Spam Rate" percentage check was previously comparing against the inbox rate instead of the actual spam rate. This has been corrected — the extension will now properly stop when the spam rate reaches or exceeds the configured threshold.

⚠️ Note: If you were using the "Max spam rate (%)" setting, the behavior will now match what the label describes. Please review your configured threshold values to make sure they reflect your intended spam rate limit.

Hi Team,

A new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is ready. This release adds a new scheduling option and fixes a stability issue.

Here's what changed:

• Stop Deferred IPs for Next Drop – You can now choose to stop carrying over deferred IPs into the next drop instead of automatically re-queuing them. This gives you more control over which IPs get retried and when.

• Server Connectivity Fix – Previously, if the status API server was unreachable (down, connection refused, DNS failure, etc.), the extension could incorrectly stop the warmup process. This has been fixed — the extension now treats server unavailability as a temporary condition and keeps the process running, only showing a warning indicator while it retries in the background.

Hi Team,

A new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is now available.

This update includes changes to the API communication and server connection process to support our new server infrastructure, improving compatibility, stability, and reliability.

Important: This update is required. Older versions will no longer work correctly after 01/08/2026.

Hi Team,

A new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is now available.

• Before stopping, the extension will automatically send the full Warmup Report of the last drop and save it to the database — ensuring no drop data is lost when the process is halted due to spam.

• Added a new "Deferred IPs must Complete all drops" option. When enabled, the extension automatically runs extra drop cycles after the main process finishes — targeting only the IPs that were skipped (deferred) during earlier drops.

Hi Team,

A new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is now available.

  • Fixed the send offset logic for Warmup Lists: the extension now correctly remembers where it left off in the list across groups and drops, instead of restarting from 0 too often. This means the list is used more efficiently and evenly, with fewer wasted or repeated positions.

  • The offset only resets to 0 when the process actually switches to a different list — for example when a list's quota runs out and it moves to the next one.

Hi Team,

A new version of the IPs Warmup Extension is now available.

• Added a new "Start From" option: by default, the extension now automatically remembers the last send offset and resumes from it on the next launch, instead of starting back at 0.

• When enabled, this toggle also lets you manually set a specific starting offset for the next process, giving you direct control over where sending resumes.

• The last saved offset is now shown at the top of the extension popup, so you always know exactly where an interrupted process left off.

What changed: The Data Provider and Data Profile dropdown selection (and the preflight validation that checks them) previously required an exact keyword:

Data Provider had to contain "data_TSS"
Data Profile had to contain "Seeds"

Now: Each field accepts either of two keywords, since the actual option text varies:

Data Provider matches "data_TSS" or "Seeds"
Data Profile matches "Seeds" or "seeds_TSS"
